mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM `transaction` WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND txn_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND txn_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND txn_type = 'PAYMENT'

SELECT p.pet_id, p.name AS pet_name, SUM(t.price) AS amount FROM `transaction` t JOIN pet p ON p.pet_id = t.pet_id AND p.is_active = 1 WHERE t.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND t.txn_type = 'PAYMENT' AND t.txn_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND t.txn_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY p.pet_id, p.name ORDER BY amount DESC, p.pet_id

SELECT t.category, t.pet_id, p.name AS pet_name, SUM(t.price) AS amount FROM `transaction` t LEFT JOIN pet p ON p.pet_id = t.pet_id WHERE t.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND t.txn_type = 'PAYMENT' AND t.txn_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND t.txn_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY t.category, t.pet_id, p.name ORDER BY t.category, amount DESC, t.pet_id
